## Summary

A clear button under every stock section on the home page, with the live count: "Bekijk het volledige aanbod (2.638 voertuigen)" under the newest row, "Bekijk alle 896 vrachtwagens" under each category row ("Bekijk", the plain word the sector uses, not "Ontdek"). The small link in the heading stays. Translated in the four other languages.

## After merge

Deploy; nothing else.
